title: Schneider Electric APC Easy UPS Online FileUploadServlet processRequest Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Schneider Electric APC Easy UPS Online. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileUploadServlet class.
